title: Bored holes.
officialText:
A hole not greater in diameter than 40 percent of the stud depth is permitted to be bored in any wood stud.
Bored holes not greater than 60 percent of the depth of the stud are permitted in nonbearing partitions or in any wall where each
bored stud is doubled, provided not more than two such successive doubled studs are so bored. In no case shall the edge of th e
bored hole be nearer than 0.625 inch (15.9 mm) to the edge of the stud. Bored holes shall not be located at the same section of stud
as a cut or notch.
